finalText:
**Migrated 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All 36 call sites converted.

Files spanned `accounts`, `billing`, `catalog`, `orders`, `support`, `analytics`. `node --check` passes on every file. `cache.query` calls were left alone. They are a different API.

I skipped `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. It has 2 `db.query` calls but its header says do not edit. Upgrades overwrite it.

Next: decide on `legacy-orm`. Patch upstream or drop the vendored copy.
